name: Reliance Capital Limited
remarksWeb: (*) As per disclosure, pursuant to Regulation 30(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 received from the Promoters along with Persons Acting in Concert, 12,65,000 (0.50%) equity shares were purchased by the discretionary Portfolio Manager of Smt. Kokila D. Ambani under the Portfolio Management Scheme (PMS). The same have been credited to a separate Demat Account specifically opened for PMS purpose as per the SEBI requirements.  No voting or other rights / interest is held on those shares, except the economic interest in PMS.  This is disclosed by way of an abundant caution.(#)  As per disclosure received from Reliance Interactive Advisors Private Limited under Regulation 7(1)(b) of SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015, Pursuant to Scheme of Amalgamation of Reliance lnceptum Private Limited (the Transferor Company) with Reliance Interactive Advisors Private Limited (the Transferee Company), as sanctioned by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench vide order dated 5th January, 2024 (the Scheme), with effect from 1st April, 2022 (the Appointed Date). 23,964 equity shares out of total holding of 1,53,964 equity shares of Reliance Capital Limited held by the Transferor Company stand transferred to and vested in favour of the Transferee Company upon the Scheme becoming effective on 30th January, 2024 (the Effective Date). 1,30,000 equity shares, pledged by the Transferor still stand in the name of the Transferor. Pursuant to the Scheme Shares were transferred from the demat account of Transferor Company to the de mat account of Transferee Company on 11th December, 2024.
